graph.title: LEGO Architecture 21026 Venice

new_part_types.name: Brick 1x1 with side stud, headlight type (white)

notes: Element IDs come from the inventory page (107). The set has two kinds of numbering: the base is built in steps 1-22; the skyline in steps 23-56. Ids b1..b132 follow build order, except sub-assemblies built more than once, which are in repeats.

The manual only shows pictures with no per-stud placements. Which exact lower piece each upper piece touches (base plates, top-layer gray plates and tiles) is inferred from the step images and is approximate; every connection is stud.top / anti-stud.bottom.

Several inventory IDs are matched to parts by shape and count: 4211356 as 1x4 tile, 4211397 as 2x2 plate (4 used: b12, b34, b40, tower base b102), 4211189 as brown plate 2x4 (domes 1 and 2), 4216695 as brown plate 2x2, 4223303 as grooved brick 1x2, 4224792 as the window slope, 6059185 as the round-ended brick for the belfry columns, 365901 as arch 1x4 and 4520970 as arch 1x3.
Colours are assumed from the pictures (black base, light gray tiles, trans light blue water, sand green roofs, reddish brown brickwork).

Windows (4224792) are shown being inserted into holes of the 1x2 Technic bricks; modelled as an insert join with null port because the catalogue slope has no pin port. Side-mounted grille units and window slopes attach to stud.side ports of 407001 / 6058177 / 4558952.

Rialto bridge: two 1x6 arch plates (b75 front, b76 back) rest on 2x2 plates b34/b40; each row has a Technic brick, 6 cones (the outer two on b34/b40, the inner four on the arch plate), 6 slopes on the cones and 2 slopes on the Technic brick. Stud counts do not fully reconcile.
Bridge of Sighs (right end): two 1x4 arches (b127, b128) rest across white plates b67 and b68, each topped by a grille tile and a curved bow slope.
Domes 1 and 2 are identical except slope orientation (mirror override). Dome 3 (b92-b101) is separate with a round grille tile on two sand-green plates attached to side studs.
Pillars: both columns are jumper plate, round plate, bar, round plate, then torch top (copy 1) or statue (copy 2, replace).
Colour: the Venice nameplate is tile 6135202; lion brick 6142085 is printed. One 4211397 and the ordering of tile/plate sub-steps in 26-27 are assumptions.
